title: Massive Update for AMD Stock Investors
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc downgrades AMD from BUY to HOLD, +37% since his Sep 3 upgrade (entered ~$452; stock now above $655, up 205% YTD). The downgrade is purely valuation: his $419 intrinsic value is far below the market price. He recaps an unusually well-timed year of AMD calls — upgrading near ~$190 earlier in the year, downgrading to HOLD above $500, re-upgrading at ~$455 on Sep 3 — and says the price has tracked his fair-value estimates more closely than usual, which lifts his confidence in the framework from low to medium. Fundamentals remain excellent: Meta as a major customer, strong agentic-AI positioning, and his forecast of FCF growing ~6x from $7.5B this year to $44B in 2030. But with sentiment extremely positive and the price well ahead of intrinsic value, he sees no buying opportunity at these levels. Call: AMD HOLD (downgrade announced in-video; first tracked in calls.json, so no flip flagged against a prior tracked stance).
